run_queue_list: run the queue command to list all queued work specs sorted by priority
run_queue_remove: run the queue command to remove a queued work spec by its node ID
run_queue_priority: run the queue command to update the priority value of a queued work spec
review_run_function: review the _run function that inspects and edits queued work via checkpoint JSON
review_parse_args: review the _parse_args function that defines list, remove, and priority subcommands
